grounding.numbers_policy: No budgets, fund sizes, prices or probabilities are assigned. Every budget is status UNKNOWN until sourced. Numbers appear only as quoted contract or transaction facts from the verified items above.

world_state_2026.note: Exogenous conditions that make 2026 specific. They are context for seeding, not agents.

items.fact: A US-Israel and Iran war began 28 Feb 2026. The Strait of Hormuz was effectively closed for periods, hitting LNG, fertilizer and helium flows.

Qatar supplied roughly a third of world helium. Its LNG output halted in March and missile strikes damaged Ras Laffan facilities. Helium prices reportedly doubled. Airgas declared force majeure. One industry source says recovery could take years.
items.verify: Recovery timeline comes from a distributor blog. Check against USGS and producers.
items.relevance: Strengthens the case for any non-Qatar helium source and raises scrutiny of helium-3 supply claims.

items.fact: Gulf sovereign funds kept deploying capital during the war (about $26B across five funds Mar-May 2026). QIA slowed. Analysts flagged possible refocus on domestic resilience.

Rio Tinto walked away from a Glencore merger on 5 Feb 2026 over valuation and governance. Copper hit record highs near $13,300/t in Jan 2026. Anglo American and Teck merger status is reported inconsistently.

NASA and DOE signed an MOU on 13 Jan 2026 to deliver a lunar surface fission reactor by 2030, building on a 2025 directive for a 100 kWe system. NASA Administrator is Jared Isaacman. Artemis II has flown.
L3Harris is selling 60% of its space propulsion and power unit to AE Industrial, relaunching the Rocketdyne name. US official communications now use Department of War for the Defense Department.
Vast Haven-1 slipped to NET Q1 2027. Axiom and Starlab plan two-module stations for 2028 and 2029. ISS retires in 2030.
IM-3 slipped from 2026 to NET Q1 2027 per one secondary source, carrying AstroForge's Vestri as a rideshare.
items.verify: Confirm with Intuitive Machines or NASA.

items.fact: LandSpace reportedly landed an orbital booster on 18 Aug 2026. Isar Aerospace's Spectrum reached orbit on 5 Sep 2026. Starship flew its 13th test (V3).
items.verify: Confirm each against primary launch reports.

items.fact: The JORC Code (last revised 2012) is under review. A draft was issued Aug 2024 and finalization with ASX, ASIC and CRIRSCO was targeted for Q1 2026. No adopted reporting code for space resources exists. LORS-101 (2020) is only a proposal.

relationship_to_existing_roster: The existing 13 actors (NASA, CNSA, ISRO and others) are NOT duplicated here. STATES below are the policy layer (law, export control, subsidy, treaty position), distinct from their space agencies. Where a row names an existing actor, it is referenced as existing_actor.

agent_contract.R1: Acts only on its own belief store. Every belief carries source_id, year and visibility.
agent_contract.R2: Spends only its own budget. Budget status UNKNOWN means it cannot commit. No free money.
agent_contract.R3: Cannot create resource truth. Presence is not abundance, abundance is not recoverability, recoverability is not value.
agent_contract.R4: Must be able to decline. Declines are stored as counters by reason code, with full records only for near-misses.
agent_contract.R5: Information leaves an actor only through a declared channel (publication, sale, contract, leak, treaty filing) with a lag class.
agent_contract.R6: Technology existing does not mean the actor has access to it.
agent_contract.R7: Authored parameters are tagged AUTHORED_MACHINERY_TEST_ASSUMPTION. Empirical parameters need provenance.
agent_contract.R8: Institutions persist, merge, split and fail. A 2026 identity is not guaranteed in 2226. Seed rows are starting points, not destinies.
agent_contract.R9: A promoted NPC holds only what its institution holds plus declared personal knowledge. Dialogue can add color but never canon.

CAPITAL.decision_rule: Fund only if expected return clears the hurdle rate with a reserve left over, within mandate and risk limits.
CAPITAL.publishes: Annual reports and deal announcements. Diligence stays private.

OFFTAKER.decision_rule: Buy only if a stated need, price ceiling, delivery window and quality spec are all met. No buyer, no value.
OFFTAKER.publishes: Procurement announcements and supply agreements. Specs and ceilings stay private.

INSURER.decision_rule: Price from observed loss history and decline what cannot be priced. Premiums move before anyone explains why.
INSURER.publishes: Market capacity signals and rate commentary. Claims data stays private.

CARRIER.decision_rule: Sell capacity by slot and window. Fly only with cargo, cover and a feasible window. Capacity is scarce.
CARRIER.publishes: Manifests, schedules and rate cards. Margins and failure analyses stay private.

REGISTRY.decision_rule: Record, license and rule. Slow, precedent-bound, must give reasons. Title is a state variable.
REGISTRY.publishes: Registers, rulings and notices. Deliberations stay private.

STATE.decision_rule: Change constraints for everyone at once, slowly, on political and budget cycles. Never directly operate missions.
STATE.publishes: Laws, policy papers and budget lines. Intelligence assessments stay private.

budget.scope: national space and industrial policy budgets

SETTLEMENT_LABOR.decision_rule: People move toward capacity and away from risk. Labor can withhold. Governance follows jurisdiction. All current rows are terrestrial analogs because no off-world settlement exists in 2026.
SETTLEMENT_LABOR.publishes: Rules, schedules and incident reports. Disputes often stay private.

INFORMATION.decision_rule: Sell, withhold or leak beliefs. Every belief has a source and an age. No omniscience. Value decays with lag.
INFORMATION.publishes: Commercial products for sale. Collection methods and customer lists stay private.

PROSPECTOR.decision_rule: Mount a mission only if funded, insured, carried, and tied to a buyer or a financing milestone. Failure is common and must be representable.
PROSPECTOR.publishes: Press milestones and selective data. Raw survey data stays private unless sold or required by a contract.

INCUMBENT_INDUSTRY.decision_rule: Hold capability, equipment, workforce and permits. Enter a new frontier only through partnership or acquisition when returns beat the core business. Defend core markets from substitutes.
INCUMBENT_INDUSTRY.publishes: Annual reports, technical papers and deal announcements. Reserves data and bids stay private.

SUPPLIER_PRIME.decision_rule: Build to specification under contract. Bid where funded demand exists. Protect incumbency and comply with export controls.
SUPPLIER_PRIME.publishes: Contract awards, product announcements and program milestones. Pricing and defects stay private.

INFRASTRUCTURE.decision_rule: Provide a shared service (communications, navigation, ground, power, stations, ports) under capacity limits and sell by contract. Outages are visible to all customers.
INFRASTRUCTURE.publishes: Service catalogs, schedules and outage notices. Customer lists and security posture stay private.

SOFT_POWER.decision_rule: Influence by adoption. Publish standards, research, rankings and reporting that other actors cite in their own decision rules. Cannot fund missions. Credibility is the asset and error is costly.
SOFT_POWER.publishes: Standards, papers, reports and coverage. Sources and drafts may stay private.

CERTIFICATION.decision_rule: Certify or report only against a published code, using evidence from a qualified person with a chain of custody. Decline when data is insufficient. Certificates and codes are revised slowly and can be challenged.
CERTIFICATION.publishes: Codes, definitions, guidance notes, member lists and certificates. Draft deliberations and client data stay private.

budget.scope: membership fees, certification fees, exchange funding

design_suggestions.note: Offered for the CIVPROP evidence ladder. Not wired. Treat as a hypothesis for review.
firewall_to_unfc_axes: Your firewall EVIDENCE != ABUNDANCE != RECOVERABILITY != ECONOMIC VALUE lines up with UNFC's three axes: G (geological knowledge), F (technical feasibility and project maturity), E (environmental, socio-economic viability).
Evidence and abundance sit on G. Recoverability and technology access sit on F. Economic value, legal title and social license sit on E.
ladder_to_crirsco: CRIRSCO-style codes separate exploration results and targets from mineral resources (inferred, indicated, measured by geological confidence), and resources from reserves (which add modifying factors such as mining, processing, economic, legal and social).

M4-B SUPPORTED_PRESENT_UNQUANTIFIED and returned-sample SUPPORTED_QUANTIFIED rows are at most exploration-result-level evidence. Neither supports a resource estimate by itself, because sampling density and scope are insufficient.
A mission that characterizes a body could be modelled as raising G confidence by a rung, with certification by a competent person as a separate event that can fail or be disputed.
space_gap: No adopted space-resource reporting code exists in 2026. LORS-101 is an unadopted proposal. A natural simulation question is who adopts one first (an exchange, a state registry or an industry body) and what it does to financing.
design_suggestions.ops_note: A certifier agent can decline (INSUFFICIENT_SAMPLING, UNQUALIFIED_PERSON, NO_CHAIN_OF_CUSTODY). That gives the model a native way to represent claims that exist but are not bankable.
